correctness.rationale: PASS: Contracting any fixed bipartite path and using the matrix-tree theorem gives cofactor determinant b^(a-rA)a^(b-rB)(1-(a-rA)(b-rB)/(ab)). Counting ordered paths between either endpoint type and telescoping gives all displayed falling-factorial tails. The log of each birthday product yields Rayleigh when both parts diverge. Fresh direct enumeration of spanning trees checked 105 exact rational tail identities on small bipartitions; this does not establish the unbounded case.
